environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate with Aurora PostgreSQL. Database connection uses role 'app_contact_ro' which was provisioned via Terraform aws_rds_cluster module with a post-provisioning SQL script that runs: REVOKE ALL ON contact_submissions FROM app_contact_ro; GRANT SELECT ON contact_submissions TO app_contact_ro; The TypeORM connection string references this read-only role. SMTP egress is routed through an internal AWS PrivateLink endpoint to Amazon SES with a configuration set that has a sending authorization policy requiring verified identities only. The SES configuration set 'contact-form-prod' has content filtering enabled via a receipt rule that drops messages with malformed headers (header line containing CR/LF sequences). Additionally, the ECS task role has no ses:SendRawEmail permission, only ses:SendEmail with condition key ses:FromAddress matching 'noreply@company.internal'.

config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT ON contact_submissions TO app_contact_ro; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON contact_submissions FROM app_contact_ro;
config.ses_configuration_set: contact-form-prod with content filtering receipt rule
config.ecs_task_role_policy: ses:SendEmail with StringEquals condition ses:FromAddress=noreply@company.internal, no ses:SendRawEmail
